_why: ADR 0079's CSV mutations, re-derived under scripts/mutate.py.
NOT MY RECORD. Written by a concurrent agent, and this file was added
instead of asking them for it -- three previous passes put a line in
NOT-YET-REPRODUCIBLE.txt asking, and the baseline itself now says that
if a fifth arrived the answer was not another document.
Writing the set is additive: it creates one file under docs/mutations/
and touches nothing they wrote. If a result had disagreed with their
table, the disagreement would have been raised for them to resolve --
correcting somebody else's record on the strength of my own spec is
how ADR 0026's near-miss would have become a false accusation.
test: cd Science-Agent-Pipeline/artifacts/api-server && npx vitest run src/__tests__/dataSources.test.ts src/__tests__/trajectoryCsv.test.ts

mutations.description: the attribution block never reaches the CSV
mutations._note: The ADR 0039 defect class applied to a licence obligation: BRENDA is CC BY 4.0, and the attribution has to be inside the artifact that travels or it does not travel.

mutations.description: every source credited regardless of contribution
mutations._note: Crediting a source that contributed nothing to THIS export is a false statement about where the numbers came from -- the same shape as the `literatureFound` column of ADR 0056, in the direction of over-claiming.
mutations.find:
const used = sourcesUsed(provenance, sources);
  if (used.length === 0) return [];
mutations.replace:
const used = sources.map((source) => ({ source, label: source.name }));
  if (used.length === 0) return [];

mutations._note: Without the prefix the licence notice becomes data rows, so `read_csv(comment="#")` parses them as the trajectory. The notice would corrupt the file it exists to accompany.
